"He sent me a personal invitation."
"I found his... experiment in the Fringe. I'm returning it to him."
Enter
"I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore."
"I'm $playerName. You invited me to see you."
"You sent a message about doing a job."
"You sent a message about 'an old mystery'. I'd like to help solve it."
"You sent me a message. I was interested in the 'vast fortune'."
"This chair has a datacore in it."
Cough pointedly and look toward the chair
"Find the sensor array, extract the data. Sounds simple."
"I haven't agreed to anything yet, Elek."
"Why is this data so important? What did this sensor array find?"
"In your message, you mentioned a reward. The words 'vast fortune' were used."
"I didn't get a clear answer about this reward. How much is it?"
"Who exactly is this 'friend' of yours?"
"I'm not interested right now."
"I told you, I'm not working for Tri-Tachyon."
"Are you sure? Sounds low for a trip to the Fringe, much less the Abyss."
"Uh, thank you. That seems... sufficient."
"That's absurdly, even insultingly low."
"100,000 would be the baseline. And a large hazard fee for the Abyss."
"Tri-Tachyon is backing your project?"
"Glad to hear it. I expect more than 100,000 credits, plus hazard."
"So it is Tri-Tachyon. They can afford at least 200,000 credits, plus hazard."
"I won't work for Tri-Tachyon."
"Glad to hear it. I expect more than 100,000 credits, plus hazard."
"Tri-Tachyon can afford at least 200,000 credits, plus hazard."
"More noble, by far, is your willingness to take up this cause." (lie)
"As I am key to this expedition, I'd like to know more of your patron and my benefactor."
Nod enthusiastically as if you are entranced by his words
"So... there's something in the Abyss."
"Aren't you a planetologist? This seems outside your field."
"I'm sure we'll manage."
"Wait, which end goes in the sensor array again?"
"I gave your proposal some more thought. I accept."
"I gave your proposal some more thought. I decline."

"Transmitting data now..."
